title: specy-road review record
description: YAML front matter of work/reviews/<NODE_ID>/REVIEW-<model>.md: one reviewer's verdict on one implementation commit. The Markdown body below the front matter holds the reviewer's notes.

model.description: Reviewer model id (roster id). human is written only by the interactive approve in mark-implementation-reviewed.

family.description: Filled from the roster by `specy-road review record`; the gate ignores this field and uses the roster.

toolkit_version.description: The specy-road build that filed this record (``specy-road --version``).

commit.description: The commit reviewed (quote it). The gate counts a record only while this is the commit under review: the branch tip, skipping commits that touch only roadmap/registry.yaml.

delta_from.description: Set (quoted) when the review read a delta packet: the earlier commit this reviewer approved, whose change since is all it reviewed. Under policy.delta_review the gate counts such an approval only when the same model's counting approval of this commit is on file and the delta still qualifies; omit it for a full review.

acceptance.description: Result per acceptance id from the brief (A1..An), plus one entry per line the packet lists under 'Required check: unplanned test removal', keyed by that integrity line exactly (e.g. "removed-test: tests/test_x.py::test_old": pass; only pass, since an unjustified removal is a block with a required_changes entry).

^(removed-test|removed-test-file|new-ski.description: The reviewer checked this unplanned removal against the acceptance and the diff and finds it justified; otherwise block with a required_changes entry.

verify_pre_existing.description: Verifier commands from the READY file that the reviewer claims already fail on the integration branch. Only approving records count, and a claim clears a failing READY verifier only after `specy-road review check-pre-existing` ran the command twice on the integration tip, both runs exited non-zero, and that tip is still current (work/reviews/<NODE_ID>/PRE-EXISTING.md).

fresh_session.description: The review ran in a session that saw only the review packet.

authored_fix.description: The reviewing session wrote any part of the change under review.

is_coordinator.description: The reviewing session is the coordinator's own session.

launch_mode.description: How the reviewer's harness was started, from `specy-road review record --launch-mode`: full (it loaded the repository's hooks, MCP servers and instructions, as an interactive session does), bare (none of them: Claude Code --bare) or explicit (only the settings and MCP servers the command named). Optional; a record without it says nothing about the mode.

human_filed.description: Who filed this record by hand and why, from `specy-road review record --human-filed` when the caller has no harness marker or worker id; part of the signed bytes. The gate counts such a record only when its signature verifies or policy.count_human_filed_reviews is on.

harness_model.description: The model the reviewer's harness reported running (its init or result events; on a mismatch, the reported model that differs), written by specy-road when it launched the reviewer (`prompt --channel cli --run`). Absent when the harness reported none.

model_mismatch.description: Written by specy-road when harness_model is not the roster entry's model after normalising case, separators and display names. The gate does not count such a record: harness ran a different model.

sibling_heads.description: HEAD of each sibling repository (a git repository under the project root that the root repository does not track and nested_repos does not configure) when the record was filed, by project-relative path; written by `specy-road review record`. The gate counts the record only while these are still the siblings' HEADs and none has uncommitted changes.

independence.description: Written by `specy-road review record` when policy requires distinct families.

notes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the Markdown notes below the front matter (line endings normalised, trailing whitespace dropped); written by `specy-road review record` and part of the signed bytes. The gate rejects a record whose body no longer matches, and a signed record without it.

signature.description: Base64 of the reviewer's OpenSSH signature (`ssh-keygen -Y sign`, namespace specy-road-review) over the canonical front matter (which includes notes_sha256); written by `specy-road review record --sign-key`. Verified against the roster entry's public_key.
